shoplift.name: Shoplifting
shoplift.success: You pocket something small and walk out. Nobody looks up. You net {{money}}.
shoplift.caught: A security guard with nothing else going on in his life tackles you by the door.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocketing
pickpocket.success: A crowded bus, a loose bag, a quick hand. You come away with {{money}}.
pickpocket.caught: The wallet was attached to a very observant man. He is also a retired boxer.

vandalism.name: Vandalism
vandalism.success: You redecorate a bus shelter. It is arguably an improvement. You find {{money}} in change nearby.
vandalism.caught: A passing patrol car illuminates you and your spray can like a stage act.

burglary.name: Burglary
burglary.success: Nobody is home and the window was open. You leave with {{money}} of other people's things.
burglary.caught: The neighbour's dog and the neighbour both had opinions. So did the police.

car_theft.name: Car Theft
car_theft.success: The car starts on the second try. You sell it to a man who asks no questions for {{money}}.
car_theft.caught: The car had a tracker. Your plan did not include trackers.

drug_dealing.name: Drug Dealing
drug_dealing.success: Business is steady, customers are loyal, and you clear {{money}}.
drug_dealing.caught: Your best customer turns out to be your worst mistake. He was wearing a wire.

fraud.name: Fraud
fraud.success: The paperwork is flawless. The money arrives. So does {{money}}, which is the part you were hoping for.
fraud.caught: Your forged signature was spelled correctly, which is how the auditors knew it was forged.

bank_robbery.name: Bank Robbery
bank_robbery.success: The teller stays calm and so do you. You leave with {{money}} and an overdeveloped sense of destiny.
bank_robbery.caught: The dye pack was the least of your worries. The helicopter was the most.

train_robbery.name: Train Robbery
train_robbery.success: It is the wrong century for this, which is probably why nobody planned for it. You escape with {{money}}.
train_robbery.caught: The train had more security than a bank, and a conductor with strong feelings.

extortion.name: Extortion
extortion.success: Your politely worded threats are politely paid. You collect {{money}}.
extortion.caught: He recorded the whole thing. He seemed to enjoy it more than you did.

arson.name: Arson
arson.success: The fire does what fires do. The insurance pays out {{money}} and asks nothing.
arson.caught: Investigators found your fingerprints on a petrol can labelled with your name.

murder.name: Murder
murder.success: You get away with it, which is a sentence you will carry longer than any court could give.
murder.caught: There is a body, a witness and a very short trial.

mischief.name: Mischief
mischief.success: You caused some trouble and got away with it.
mischief.caught: Caught being a menace. A stern talking-to.

porch_pirate.name: Porch piracy
porch_pirate.success: You stole a neighbour's package: ${{money}} of stuff.
porch_pirate.caught: A doorbell camera saw the whole thing.

hacking.name: Hacking
hacking.success: You got into someone's accounts and walked off with ${{money}}.
hacking.caught: Traced in an afternoon. Cybercrime unit.

embezzle.name: Embezzlement
embezzle.success: You skimmed ${{money}} from work and nobody noticed.
embezzle.caught: The audit found it. Handcuffs in the lobby.
